Method of Attack: Phishing tool with extensive permissions access
Requests 21 permissions including BIND-ACCESSIBILITY_PERMISSION and BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN
Monitors and intercepts all data to/from device
Sends bulk SMS to victim’s contacts
Steals OTPs and screen lock PIN
Incorporates TeamViewer via Accessibility service abuse
Uses encrypted TOR communications and SOCKS Proxy for redirection
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones of Commerzbank customers in Germany and Central and Eastern Europe
Attack Vector: Malicious APK named 'Commerzbank Security' distributed via SMS, social media, and forum posts leading to malicious landing pages
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious APK named 'Commerzbank Security' using official app icon
